# 3 Peaks Roofing & Exteriors

> Veteran-owned roofing and full-exterior contractor based in Lowell, Michigan, serving the greater
> Grand Rapids / West Michigan area. Roof installation, repair, and replacement plus gutters, siding,
> windows, doors, decks, and skylights. 5.0-star rated with 80+ Google reviews, BBB A+ accredited,
> CertainTeed Pro Installer. Founded 2022 by Mitch Cusack.

## Key facts (verified from the company's own site)
- Legal name: 3 Peaks Roofing & Exteriors L.L.C.
- Address: 427 E Main St, Lowell, MI 49331
- Phone: (616) 902-8560
- Email: office@threepeaksroofing.com
- Hours: Open daily, 7:00 AM to 8:00 PM
- Founded: 2022 (veteran-owned)
- Owner / founder: Mitch Cusack
- Certifications: CertainTeed Pro Installer; BBB A+ accredited
- Warranty: lifetime craftsmanship warranty; 10-year workmanship warranty
- Financing: available
- Rating: 5.0 stars, 80+ Google reviews

## Services
- [Roof Installation](https://threepeaksroofing.com/roof-installation/): new roofs and full replacements built for Michigan weather.
- [Roof Repairs](https://threepeaksroofing.com/roof-repairs/): leaks, storm damage, and worn-shingle repair.
- [Gutter Installation](https://threepeaksroofing.com/gutter-installation/), [Cleaning](https://threepeaksroofing.com/gutter-cleaning/), and [Repairs](https://threepeaksroofing.com/gutter-repairs/).
- [Siding](https://threepeaksroofing.com/siding/), [Windows](https://threepeaksroofing.com/windows/), [Doors](https://threepeaksroofing.com/doors/), [Decks](https://threepeaksroofing.com/decks/), [Skylights](https://threepeaksroofing.com/skylights/).
- [Storm Damage & Insurance Claims](https://threepeaksroofing.com/storm-damage/): free inspection, documentation, adjuster meeting, and full claim handling for wind, hail, and ice damage.

## Service area (West Michigan)
Lowell, Ada, Cascade, Forest Hills, Grand Rapids, Grandville, Kentwood, Wyoming, Rockford, Caledonia,
Byron Center, Hudsonville, Jenison, Comstock Park, Walker, Cedar Springs, Belding, Ionia, Saranac,
Clarksville, Middleville, Alto, Lake Odessa, Belmont.
